overview:
Epsilon Research is a Paris-based research and financial analysis provider focused on private-company M&A and private equity. Its EMAT (Epsilon Multiple Analysis Tool) database provides European transaction multiples and deal-analysis reports for valuation work. The company also documents market studies, portfolio-valuation services and M&A CRM software.

Its website describes transaction-data coverage across industry sectors, including healthcare, software, business services and industrial goods. It serves M&A, private equity, valuation, audit and accounting, and corporate teams.

history.narrative: Epsilon dates its founding to 2007. Its recent publications include the Régions & Transmission study with In Extenso Finance and the quarterly Argos Index with Argos.

timeline.event: Company-stated founding year for its research and financial analysis business.
Argos announced the Q3 2025 Argos Index, jointly published with Epsilon Research.
In Extenso Finance published the tenth Régions & Transmission study in partnership with Epsilon, analyzing 1,076 French SME transactions from 2025 with 12 regional studies.
Argos announced the Q2 2026 Argos Index, jointly published with Epsilon Research to track eurozone private-company acquisition valuations.
